skill.summary: Designs customized bodyweight and minimal-equipment home workouts tailored to your space, equipment, time, fitness level, and noise constraints.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Home Workout Designer.
- Creates custom home or travel workout plans using your available space, equipment, time, and fitness goals.
- Includes apartment-friendly, low-noise, and small-space options.
- Provides warm-up, cool-down, and safe progression ideas for all fitness levels.
- Ensures every exercise is safe for unsupervised, at-home practice, with alternatives for equipment or space constraints.
